prompts.ripe: Create one isolated custom wheat FIELD sprite for an isometric Greek island strategy game. Use the attached farm only as reference for fine dark-brown ink lines, restrained painted two-tone cel shading, warm upper-left sunlight, cool teal shadows, and camera. The new field is ONLY a square patch of ochre-brown ploughed earth with six dense straight rows of ripe golden wheat, and a few tiny pale limestone edging stones. NO building, NO shed, NO walls, NO fence, NO people, NO scarecrow, NO tools. Very low profile, rooted in the soil, not a floating block. Fixed orthographic isometric camera, equal left and right diamond edges, ground diamond about twice as wide as tall. Entire diamond visible, centered, fills 85 percent of image width. Clean pure white background, no cast shadow outside the soil, no scenery, no text. Highly readable golden crop masses with individual wheat ears in fine ink. One single field, not a sheet.
